title: No external oxidizer: fuel jet into pure nitrogen versus separately supplied oxidizer
summary: Variant A: methane against a pure-nitrogen stream - there is nothing to react with. Variant B: methane against a separately supplied oxygen/nitrogen stream - a diffusion flame forms between the two supplied streams, independent of any ambient atmosphere.
expected_behaviour: Variant A is reported as the non-reacting branch (no O2 in either stream, peak temperature equals the inlet temperature). Variant B gives a counterflow diffusion flame near 2000 K.
acceptance_checks: Variant A: peak temperature below 400 K and the result is labelled as not burning.
Variant B: peak temperature above 1700 K.

variants.label: Variant A: oxidizer stream is pure N2
Variant B: separately supplied 21 % O2 / 79 % N2 stream
